'''Zenobia le Ingiana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] and the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. She was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].
